configurations.name: uxwoz-night
runtimeArgs: cd src && PORT=3001 UXWOZ_CACHE_FILE=../temp/screen-cache-night.json bun run dev

configurations.name: uxwoz-public
runtimeArgs: cd src && D=$(mktemp -d) && echo files in $D && PORT=3200 UXWOZ_PUBLIC=1 UXWOZ_OWNER=letmein UXWOZ_ADMIN_EMAIL=owner@example.com UXWOZ_OPERATOR='The owner' UXWOZ_CACHE_FILE=$D/screen-cache.json UXWOZ_DB=$D/uxwoz.db UXWOZ_USERS_DIR=$D/users bun --env-file=../.env packages/web/src/server.ts

configurations.name: uxwoz-demo
runtimeArgs: cd src && PORT=3131 bun run demo
